title: Blackberry and juniper sorbet
introduction: Creating a flavour born of a place, its relationships and aromas.

steps.title: Territory
steps.subtitle: It all begins by listening to the place.
steps.body: Observe the landscape, soil, water, light and season. In this example, blackberry and juniper share the same environment: the Mediterranean woodland. That connection is the starting point.

steps.title: Matter
steps.subtitle: Understand before intervening.
steps.body: Blackberry brings sweetness, juiciness and wild notes. Juniper adds an aromatic, resinous woodland character. Explore their sensory expression: observe, touch, smell, taste.

steps.title: Knowledge
steps.subtitle: Time is an ingredient too.
steps.body: Research, try, make mistakes and try again. Bring ancestral knowledge, botany, technique and sensory experience into conversation to understand the ingredients.

steps.title: Relationships
steps.subtitle: Find the thread that connects them.
steps.body: The dark, rounded sweetness of blackberry creates tension with juniper’s sharp character. The place guides the combination; trials refine its balance.

steps.title: Transformation
steps.subtitle: Extract to express.
steps.body: Distil juniper berries to obtain a hydrosol and incorporate it into the sorbet. Adjust texture, sweetness and aromatic balance to express the character of the ingredients.

steps.title: Experience
steps.subtitle: The landscape becomes sensation.
steps.body: Create a synergy that transports us to the place these ingredients inhabit, with a fresh, lingering finish. What matters is what it awakens: woodland sensations, memories, associations and curiosity.

steps.title: Sharing
steps.subtitle: The creation finds its meaning in others.
steps.body: Bring it to the table, share for the pleasure of it, inhabit the sensations and leave room for wonder. Other people’s experience brings new perceptions and broadens our view. The journey begins again.
